levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: two different men named Muhammad b. al-Hasan: the compiler's shaykh and his shaykh al-Saffar; each is written in full and kept apart
the Imam is named after «قال سمعت» in the report's chain (owner ruling 2): he is the last link, written as the report names him
the Yemen story and Abu Jaʿfar's later words are his account in the saying, not new links
